ctx.x: Yes, it's doing well. It's proving to be quite a showcase for the right kind of music and so on.

Well, now, look, perhaps I was going to speak to you, about Humph and so on, but perhaps you -- we're getting near the end of this and you might just like to tell me what you feel about jazz, how you look at it.

I can say from a therapeutic point of view, it's -- there's something in the music that makes you happy when you're despondent, there's something in the music that makes you well when you're in pain. Of course, this happens to many actors. I have had nights where I had a bad headache or stomachache or maybe my feet might hurt or just some minor ailment and I'd go onstage and play and in just the very act of being on stage and performing and playing this particular kind of music, seemed to take me -- extricate me
